auditor.note: Independent i18n-auditor audit of the landed ui.chat.canonical bytes after merging main 0de7a69e2 (#1874 temporary_deleted.* + #1884 S16e keys) into PR #1884; prior audits described pre-merge bytes.

findings.note: Current 'Лимит аудио' names the object (an audio quota) where the other five class labels state the failed event; the locale's settled 'rate limit' is 'лимит запросов'. Proposed 'Лимит аудио превышен' (21 chars, 3 words). Non-blocking: the label always sits above 'Генерация аудио сейчас перегружена...', which disambiguates it.

Two renderings of 'Back to X' now ship in ru: 'Назад к ...' (ui.browser.extensions.action_back, ui.agents.pages.back_to_list) and 'Вернуться к ...' here. No change recommended: the style guide's infinitive action-label rule favours the landed form and it harmonises with the adjacent 'Начать новый чат' in the same slot.

One ru word carries two English concepts in this namespace: 'Проверка' = 'gate' here and 'Проверка' = 'checking' in image_gen.cancel.checking ('Проверка расчёта'). The rendering itself is accurate for a policy gate; no change proposed, recorded so a future gate surface does not inherit an ambiguous term.

findings.note: Term drift on EN 'settlement' inside one card: 'khoản phí' here vs 'quyết toán' in ui.chat.canonical.image_gen.settlement.pending (the adjacent note the same fact lands in), and 'Đang xác nhận khoản phí.' additionally asserts a charge exists where EN only states the settlement check is under way. Proposed: 'Đang kiểm tra quyết toán.' — or unify on the charge vocabulary in settlement.pending instead; one term either way, not two. Rendering join verified (running + ' ' + checking).

Sentence-initial 'Nó' is the odd one out beside the sibling variant of the same notice (transcript.missing_session_detail opens with 'Cuộc trò chuyện'). Both forms have locale precedent and the variants never paint together — preference only, may be declined. 'không hoạt động' for 'went quiet' is correct.

findings.note: EN 'Audio rate limited' is a state; zh-CN '音频速率限制' is the noun for the limit itself, so this one class label names a mechanism where its five siblings (参数无效, 已拒绝, 未知工具, 重复ID, 策略拦截) name an outcome. Proposed: 音频限流 — the locale's established state form (ui.code_review.host.cooling: '{host}已触发限流，将持续到{time}。'). Non-gating: meaning is recoverable, no user is misled.

Value is correct in isolation; the defect is its composition with cancel.running. The callsite (image-gen-card.tsx:339-341) joins with a hard ASCII space, painting '…若产出音频则会计费。 正在确认结算。' — a space between two full-width sentences, which is not Chinese typography. Proposed: no catalogue change; make the join locale-aware (no separator when the following value starts full-width/CJK). zh-CN is the only CJK locale in this set.
